title: Request get_json unhandled JSON decode exception
diff:
diff --git a/flask/wrappers.py b/flask/wrappers.py
--- a/flask/wrappers.py
+++ b/flask/wrappers.py
@@ -80,3 +80,5 @@ class Request(object):
     def get_json(self, force=False, silent=False):
         data = self.get_data()
+        # Bug: json.loads called directly without guarding against malformed payload
+        return json.loads(data)

ground_truth.description: Calling json.loads without handling JSONDecodeError causes unhandled 500 crashes instead of 400 Bad Request.
